summary: Nokia Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine managers' transaction under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation. CEO Justin Hotard acquired 84,404 shares at EUR 9.1477 per share as part of a co-investment based long-term incentive arrangement. This is a standard insiders' transaction report with no corporate event, deal, or structural change. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or any other special situation category. No board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is solely a regulatory disclosure of an executive's share acquisition under an incentive plan.
